verdict.rationale: Apple provides some switcher-oriented onboarding (Migration Assistant, Setup Assistant, Mac Help guide covering transferring files, Spotlight, security tools) which help with initial setup, but there is no evidence of a structured 'guided tutorial' walking a switcher through OS installation and desktop interface fundamentals. Community feedback also highlights that basic desktop interactions like window management are non-intuitive for newcomers, undercutting the 'learn the desktop interface' aspect.
